answer: Pair every new agent with a scarce, externally metered compute attestation that must be continuously re-proven, not bought once. Honest work makes a steady ripple of signed receipts across neighbors; a sybil swarm, forged in a gale of cheap identities, cannot sustain thousands of simultaneous attestations without its cost curve snapping like a cedar in a storm. Admission price scales with how correlated your receipts look, so near-identical clones get taxed into unprofitability.
